title: AMD Stock Soars After Thursday's Rout. AI Fears Take a Back Seat

impact_reason: การฟื้นตัวอย่างรวดเร็วแสดงถึงแรงซื้อสนับสนุนที่แข็งแกร่งเมื่อความกังวลเรื่องฟองสบู่ AI ลดลง

title: NVIDIA and AMD Sell-Off: Which AI Stock Is the Better Buy on the Dip?

title: Broadcom's AI Revenue Is Exploding. Here's What Investors Should Watch Next.

title: Anthropic’s “Down Quarter” Highlights Broadcom’s $161 Billion Risk

title: Intel Stock’s (INTC) Deep Sell-Off Shows Signs of an Overreaction

title: Qualcomm CEO: Its Data Center Ramp Is “All Supply Bound,” Not Demand Bound
